text.title: FreshDrop app, buyer books a delivery slot
text.goal: I want to pick a delivery slot for today, so that the order arrives after I get home
text.scope: Entry: slot picker from the cart. End: slot confirmed in the order. Payment and address editing are separate flows
text.end: Slot confirmed: the order shows the delivery window
text.cond: is the chosen slot still free?
text.alt: Slot picker: «slot taken» banner, pick another window
text.other: «Express in 30 min» and rescheduling from the order page are separate flows
text.issues: Test of 8 buyers: 3 went back to the cart to check the address and lost the slot; 2 did not see the «no free slots» state
text.decision: Merged day and time pickers into one screen; address check moved before the slot is held
text.check: 5 moderated tests after the change: all 5 picked a slot without going back; slot-to-order conversion +9 pp in a week
